html:
Juvénal Habyarimana was president of Rwanda from 1973, when he took power in a coup, until 6 April 1994, when his plane was shot down over Kigali.

An army officer from the north, he ran a one-party state that was praised by donors for order and roads, while Tutsi were kept out of the army and most posts. A crash in coffee prices in 1989 and the invasion by the Rwandan Patriotic Front in 1990 shook his rule.

Under pressure he signed a peace deal with the rebels at Arusha in 1993, which extremists around him opposed. Who shot down his plane is still disputed. Within hours of his death, the genocide began in Kigali.
sum: Juvénal Habyarimana was president of Rwanda from 1973, when he took power in a coup, until 6 April 1994, when his plane was shot down over Kigali.
